verdict.rationale: Three.js is a code-first rendering library. The only editor-related evidence is a link to the official three.js editor at threejs.org/editor, plus a devtools browser extension and TransformControls as building blocks, so there is no evidence that a visual editor is the primary way to build levels. missing for 10: documented viewport/inspector features of the editor, prefab or scene-composition workflow, evidence the editor is a primary level-building path rather than a side tool, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
